step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram illustrates Aventry's virtual event platform. Requests enter via front-end and reach Lambda 1, which communicates with AWS Chime SDK for real-time video/audio meeting orchestration. Meeting events are pushed from Chime to SQS 1 and stored in S3 1 for post-event analytics. Active meeting state is stored in DynamoDB 1. When recording starts, Chime sends messages to SQS 2, which triggers Lambda 2 to spawn ECS tasks in Fargate. Fargate uses FFmpeg and virtual browsers to render/encode recordings, managing container state via DynamoDB 2, and exporting completed recording files to S3 2.

graph.name: Aventry Virtual Events Platform Architecture
graph.notes: Architecture for Aventry virtual events using AWS Chime SDK for real-time meetings and Fargate container instances for video recording rendering.

nodes.name: Lambda 1
nodes.notes: Handles messaging and processing requests coming from the front-end application via API Gateway.

nodes.name: Chime
nodes.notes: Handles real-time audio/video meetings, TURN services, and WebRTC media streams via Chime SDK.

nodes.name: SQS 1
nodes.notes: Receives real-time event notifications from Chime (joins, leaves, mic toggles, etc.).

nodes.name: S3 1
nodes.notes: Stores archived event logs for post-event attendee interaction analytics.

nodes.name: DynamoDB 1
nodes.notes: Serves as a real-time session store to manage active meeting state.

nodes.name: SQS 2
nodes.notes: Queues recording trigger messages initiated when hosts start recording.

nodes.name: Lambda 2
nodes.notes: Triggered by SQS 2 to spawn container task instances on AWS Fargate.

nodes.name: Fargate
nodes.notes: Runs ECS containers with a virtual browser and FFmpeg encoding to record and process meeting video.

nodes.name: DynamoDB 2
nodes.notes: Tracks and manages container state lifecycle (spawn, running, teardown).

nodes.name: S3 2
nodes.notes: Stores completed recorded video files for video-on-demand playback.

edges.notes: Lambda invokes Chime SDK to create meeting sessions and add attendees.
Chime reads and updates active meeting session state stored in DynamoDB 1.
Chime emits event notifications to SQS 1.
Event messages from SQS 1 are stored in S3 1 for analytics.
Chime triggers SQS 2 when a host requests to record the meeting.
SQS 2 triggers Lambda 2 to process the recording workflow.
Lambda 2 spawns ECS container tasks in Fargate.
Fargate updates and tracks container state in DynamoDB 2.
Fargate exports finalized MP4/video files to S3 2 for playback.
